description: Lists every AAJ marketing engine: its id, the question it answers, and its category. Engines cover unit economics, pipeline forecast, budget allocation, retention, A/B significance, SEO/GEO scoring, ad spend and pricing.

category.description: Optional filter. Words are matched against the engine's category, id and skill title (for example "pricing", "retention" or "seo audit"), then against its summary.
